'''Bob Pieron''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Parker tournament (13 January)]] on 13 January 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1691">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-30-parker-co-01-13-01-the-new-era-beginsd1691/ parker-co-01-13-01-the-new-era-begins], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 30 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-30-parker-co-01-13-01-the-new-era-beginsd1691/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
